why:
whether this server was successfully created -- the same predicate every entity on this surface carries, and the reason a failed create is not a crash: `Node::create_action_server` reports through a `Result` and leaves the object valid-but-uninitialised rather than throwing (RFC-0018). rclcpp_action has no counterpart because `create_server` either returns a live `SharedPtr` or throws. See the pubsub stage's `cpp:Publisher::is_valid`.

phase-428 (RFC-0089): re-keyed by the namespace flip. `nros::ActionClient<A>` / `nros::ActionServer<A>` are now aliases of `rclcpp_action::Client<A>` / `rclcpp_action::Server<A>`, which the extractor keys as `Client::*` / `Server::*`. The type is `same` now and the member is `ours-only`, so it no longer inherits its type's verdict and carries its own.
